title: 2 PhD and 2 Postdoctoral Positions in Deep Learning and World Models
text: 2 PhD and 2 Postdoctoral Positions in Deep Learning and World Models. University of Bern, Institute of Computer Science, Switzerland. The advertised roles include 2 PhD positions in deep learning and world models.

title: 2 PhD and 2 Postdoctoral Positions in Deep Learning and World Models
text: Application Deadline: 30 Sep 2026. The projects are fully funded for four years. Applicants for PhD positions should have a master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field.

title: 2 PhD and 2 Postdoctoral Positions in Deep Learning and World Models
text: The research combines deep learning, self-supervised learning, generative AI, and world models. Apply through https://euraxess.ec.europa.eu/jobs/example-bern-world-models.

title: PhD positions in foundation models of human cognition
text: PhD positions in foundation models of human cognition. Max Planck Institute for Biological Cybernetics, Tuebingen, Germany. Apply by 01/10/26 through the ELLIS program.

title: PhD positions in foundation models of human cognition
text: The positions are funded doctoral positions studying foundation models, machine learning, and human cognition. Eligibility: applicants should have strong machine learning background and an MSc or equivalent degree.

title: PhD Studentship: Machine-learning for High-speed Aerial Vehicle Control
text: PhD Studentship: Machine-learning for High-speed Aerial Vehicle Control. University of Bristol, United Kingdom. Funding: fully funded, standard EPSRC stipend. Closes 04 Nov 2026.

title: PhD Studentship: Machine-learning for High-speed Aerial Vehicle Control
text: This PhD project focuses on machine-learning for high-speed aerial vehicle control. Eligibility: applicants should have a background in control, robotics, aerospace engineering, machine learning, or a related discipline.
